description: Defines the ILISA interface with methods for application management, storage, metadata, notifications, and application locking within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace.

classes.name: ILISA
classes.description: Interface for application lifecycle management, storage, metadata, notifications, and locking mechanisms.

classes.name: ILISA::IStorage
classes.description: Interface for storage path, quota, and usage information.

classes.name: ILISA::IStoragePayload
classes.description: Interface for retrieving storage applications and persistent data.

classes.name: ILISA::IMetadataPayload
classes.description: Interface for application metadata including name, category, URL, resources, and auxiliary metadata.

classes.name: ILISA::IApp
classes.description: Interface representing an application with type, id, and versions.

classes.name: ILISA::IAppsPayload
classes.description: Interface for list of installed applications.

classes.name: ILISA::ILockInfo
classes.description: Interface providing lock reason and owner information.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Download and install an application bundle.

methods.name: SetAuxMetadata
methods.description: Set arbitrary metadata for an application.

methods.name: ClearAuxMetadata
methods.description: Clear arbitrary metadata for an application.

methods.name: GetProgress
methods.description: Get progress of an ongoing request.

methods.name: GetList
methods.description: List installed applications based on filters.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Lock an application to prevent uninstallation.
